criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered through the kit; 5 and 7 are real places. The rest lean on primitives against an empty blue-grey gradient: 6 a slab clock on a brick fragment with no ground; 4 helmet-haired mannequins on a blank plane into fog; 9 a mannequin parent on the gutter line and the arm folded flat though the motif says out; 1 the bus flank in muddy shade reading brown, low-poly cars; 8 a bar chart before a blurred wall.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One noon light and one hero on 1, 5, 7 and 9, one interior on 2, 3 and 8. The arm motif fails on 9. Hue alternates exterior and interior. 6 and 8 sit outside the bus world.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every quote verbatim in the fetched texts and every numeral traced; every 10 to 3 attributed; Valenta never joined; c39 only with c40; 'summer of 2025' supported. Held below 8: frame 5's 2 assumes the five decliners sit inside the at least 10; frame 3 places the undated offer straight after the September 2025 reply; frame 1 compresses c12; the deck rests on journalism where TEA's own results exist. Off deck, the web edition's intro states the 10 to 3 without 'the Tribune reports'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, who and where, and a concrete step on 9. The close's 'what a pilot must prove' is general; frame 7's withheld contract was the sharper stake.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, 3 turns. 4 could go; 8 turns back to the charter question just before the close.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, specific, no rule broken. Repeated attribution reads like a wire rewrite; 9's hook leans on a metaphor; 4's hook is flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No topic repeat, but the second TEA deck in five days, the one-object count move of the last four decks, and a vehicle on a Texas road like no. 41.

one_sentence_fix: Build each exterior frame as a place rather than kit objects against a flat gradient, with cloud and a sun the shadows agree with, ground with contact, and a background to a horizon, starting with frame 6 and frames 4 and 9.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A slab clock against an empty gradient sky; no ground, beam or rimrock.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Under the covered walkway so the clock hangs from a modelled edge beam, the rimrock and a clouded sky behind, the walk with its shade band at the foot.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Helmet-haired mannequins on a blank plane fading to fog; no campus; no shade band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera behind the walkway's shade band at 1.6 m; extend the campus to the horizon; fabric and hair on the walkers.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mannequin parent on the gutter line; the arm folded flat; a flat sky.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Swing the arm out; the parent on the kerb with a contact shadow; an oak's shade pool on the sidewalk.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The bus flank in muddy shade reads brown; low-poly cars; an empty sky.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Light the east flank full; higher-detail vehicles or crop them out.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A bar chart before a blurred wall; the solid 10% box reads as a present value.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The 10% before column as a ghost glass column; a raking window light across the oak.
